decisions.reason: As a low-cost incremental burner component tied to the installed radiant-heating base, it still has option value and there is no clear evidence by 2025 that justifies withdrawal.

As a flagship electric infrared line with several models that supports the firm's electrification strategy, management would very likely keep investing while the market opportunity continues to unfold.

This halogen infrared heater remains the most vulnerable because it is less central and may overlap with other electric offers, but for an expanding firm the uncertainty around niche demand is still not fully resolved.
The industrial electric infrared hall-heater line is close to core applications and customers, so its strategic fit and multi-model format make continued commercialization more likely than exit.

The hydrogen-capable dark infrared line is a strategically important decarbonization option already proven in real operation, so the firm would normally preserve it unless adoption clearly disappoints.
